126261.overview: In this board game which is similar to Monopoly, players use money to build properties on the spaces they land on, such as farms, quarries or hotels.  These will generate more money so the player can then buy supplies to go into the middle of the board and hunt for hidden treasure.

126262.overview: Formosa Duel is a puzzle game like Puyo Puyo developed by AV Artisan. You can choose between a story mode where you will go to face to face with 12 colorful Chinese celebrities and a 2-player battle in duel mode.
